name: signature
note: ADR-D01.70 in sample mode at 1280x720: the preview view and History's entries draw the Library rows' effect signature. The sample History (its rail button, DockRail_history_sample) shows its sample entries; a sample preview is staged (operation.preview sample:0 opens the preview view). The screen's words then hold the preview's signature and each History entry's, read from their tooltips. The error lamp counts no failure.
